customers_say: Customers find the water purification unit to be of good quality, working well, and consider it a budget-friendly option. The water quality is excellent, with hard water purified to the best possible quality, and they appreciate its taste and ease of use. The service receives mixed feedback, with some customers praising the prompt service while others report extremely poor customer care and after-sales service.

reviews.author: kamalakannan
reviews.title: Very low TDS than normally allowed drinking level , no control on device
reviews.body: TDS level very low 30 which is below than normal , there is no TDS control in this device. Auquaguard installaton engineer & backend manager says this is how it works try to convince us TDS 30 is ok to drink, then why we to buy with mineral guard ? Poor customer service, installation don't have enough knowledge asked to buy addition connectors & charged us when all required already comes with unit itself

reviews.author: Chinmay
reviews.title: Good Water Purifier
reviews.body: The product doesn't have a strong body, looks are fine with all the necessary features, no fancy things like mobile app connectivity and touch sensors, just the 3 indicators, technician came on scheduled time and did his job perfectly, overall a good water purifier. one suggestion for buyers, before you buy any water purifier, test your water TDS level and then buy the relevant one, since nowadays you get all varieties, consider buying an RO purifier only if your TDS is above 300+ level or else simply buy UV+UF water purifier and save money.

reviews.author: K. Nagaraju
reviews.title: Good Product
reviews.body: Product is working fine for now. As it was only 7 days. However, the only concern thing about warranty details. Since on app it showing only 1 year. So I hope this will be cleared through customer care.

reviews.author: Argha P.
reviews.title: Good product
reviews.body: The purifier is working fine. Water tastes good, the water wastage in the process of purifying seems to be of justified amount. I hv not tested the tds though, so can not comment on that.
